topic_ko: 인터넷에 연결된 자율주행차가 늘수록 해커의 표적도 늘어난다 — 자동차 사이버 보안

passage: Cars that drive themselves and connect to the internet will soon fill our roads.
Specialists caution that every added connection is another door for an intruder.
In a recent trial, engineers seized a car that another person was driving.
From a laptop they altered the stereo, the climate control and the wipers.
They then reached the gearbox and brought the moving vehicle to a halt.
It was only a trial, yet the warning to carmakers and lawmakers was unmistakable.
choices: the security risk created by connecting more vehicles to the internet
the environmental advantages of replacing older cars with new ones
the legal difficulty of deciding who is at fault in a car accident
the engineering steps required to build a fully self-driving car
the declining demand for skilled mechanics in the motor trade
theme.explanation_ko: 연결된 차가 늘수록 침입 통로가 늘어난다는 경고와 실제 원격 장악 시연이 이어지므로 ①이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ② 환경 이점은 언급되지 않는다. ③ 사고 책임 소재는 다루지 않는다. ④ 제작 공정이 아니라 보안이 초점이다. ⑤ 정비사 수요는 오답 보기에만 등장한다.

passage: Internet-connected self-driving cars are about to become common.
Experts warn that their benefits arrive together with a new danger.
Researchers showed this by taking over a car from a computer while it was being driven.
They changed the radio and air conditioning, then took the transmission and stopped the car.
The test was harmless, but the lesson was not.
Carmakers and governments alike must treat automotive cybersecurity as a real problem.
choices: 연결된 자율주행차가 늘어날수록 해킹 위험이 커지므로 자동차 사이버 보안이 시급하다.
자율주행차는 사람이 운전하는 차보다 사고율이 훨씬 낮아 안전하다.
정부는 자율주행차의 도로 주행을 당분간 전면 금지해야 한다.
자동차 회사들은 라디오와 에어컨 같은 편의 장치를 줄여야 한다.
해킹 시연은 실제 위협이 아니므로 지나치게 걱정할 필요가 없다.
gist.explanation_ko: 연결이 늘면 위험도 는다는 경고와 시연, 그리고 업계·정부를 향한 요구가 이어지므로 ①이 요지이다.
gist.distractor_ko: ② 사고율 비교는 없다. ③ 전면 금지를 주장하지 않는다. ④ 편의 장치 축소는 논지가 아니다. ⑤ 글은 실제 문제라고 못 박는다.

passage: Soon a great many self-driving cars with internet access will share our roads.
These cars bring real benefits, but experts point to a cost that comes with them.
A demonstration proved that even the smart cars of today can be broken into.
Working from a computer, researchers controlled a car while someone else drove it.
They handled the radio and the wipers, then the transmission, stopping the car outright.
Automotive cybersecurity, the demonstration said plainly, is a real issue.
choices: Every New Connection Is a New Door for Hackers
Self-Driving Cars Will End Traffic Jams for Good
Why Drivers Still Prefer to Hold the Steering Wheel
The Race to Build the Fastest Electric Vehicle
How Insurance Companies Price a Modern Car
title.explanation_ko: 연결된 차가 늘수록 침입 경로가 늘어난다는 것이 글의 핵심이므로 ①이 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ② 교통 체증은 오답 보기 소재다. ③ 운전자 선호는 없다. ④ 속도 경쟁은 무관하다. ⑤ 보험료 산정도 다루지 않는다.

passage: Self-driving cars with internet access will soon be everywhere.
Researchers took control of a moving car using only a computer.
They adjusted the radio and the wipers, then stopped the car on the highway.
Fortunately no one was hurt, because the whole event was arranged.
Still, experts say that more self-driving cars means more potential targets for hackers.
Every car that joins the network widens the door that was already open.
implication.underlined: widens the door that was already open
choices: each newly connected vehicle increases the opportunities available to attackers
older cars are far easier for criminals to break into than new ones
car doors should be fitted with stronger mechanical locks
drivers tend to leave their vehicles unlocked in public places
manufacturers deliberately hide security flaws from their customers
implication.explanation_ko: "이미 열려 있던 문을 더 넓힌다"는 것은 연결 차량이 늘수록 공격 기회가 늘어난다는 뜻이므로 ①이 함축 의미이다.
implication.distractor_ko: ② 구형 차와의 비교는 없다. ③ 물리적 잠금장치 이야기가 아니다. ④ 운전자의 부주의는 언급되지 않는다. ⑤ 결함 은폐는 나오지 않는다.

passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road.
Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more of them also means more risk.
Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even today’s smart cars are vulnerable.
They used a computer taking control of a car while someone else was driving it.
They were not only able to change the radio’s volume but also able to stop the car.
It sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government.

underlines.text: having more of them also means
both the auto industry and the government

grammar.explanation_ko: "장악하기 위해 컴퓨터를 사용했다"는 목적을 나타내므로 현재분사 taking 이 아니라 목적의 to부정사 to take 가 되어야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① There + be 구문으로 적절하다. ② 동명사 주어는 단수 취급이므로 means 가 맞다. ④ not only A but also B 의 앞부분으로 적절하다. ⑤ both A and B 가 명사구끼리 병렬을 이룬다.

passage: Soon many self-driving cars with internet access will be on the road.
Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn about a hidden cost.
Researchers proved through a demonstration that even smart cars are vulnerable.
They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it.
They could change the radio, adjust the air conditioner, and switch the wipers on.
Fortunately it was just a demonstration, so the danger it revealed was imaginary.
vocab.explanation_ko: 시연이었을 뿐이지만 드러난 위험은 실제라는 것이 글의 결론이므로 imaginary(상상의)는 정반대다. real 이 되어야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ① 이점을 인정하는 양보절이므로 benefits 가 맞다. ② 뚫렸으므로 vulnerable 이 적절하다. ③ take control of 가 관용 표현이다. ④ 에어컨을 조절했으므로 adjust 가 맞다.

passage: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road.
Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more of them also means having ______________________.
Researchers recently took over a car from a computer while another person was driving it.
They handled the radio and the wipers, then seized the transmission and stopped the car.
Fortunately it was only a demonstration.
Yet it told both the auto industry and the government that automotive cybersecurity is real.
choices: more traffic jams during rush hour
blank.explanation_ko: 빈칸 뒤가 모두 원격 장악 시연과 사이버 보안 경고이므로, 연결된 차가 늘수록 해커의 표적이 늘어난다는 ①이 적절하다.
blank.distractor_ko: ② 정비사 실직은 글에 없다. ③ 교통 체증은 다루지 않는다. ④ 사고 증가가 아니라 침입 가능성이 핵심이다. ⑤ 시연의 목적은 절도가 아니라 취약성 입증이다.

irrelevant.intro: Many self-driving cars with internet access will soon be on the road, and experts warn that this brings a new kind of risk.
sentences: Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even smart cars are vulnerable.
They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it.
They changed the radio and the air conditioner, then stopped the car on the highway.
The first mass-produced automobile appeared in the United States in the early 1900s.
The demonstration told the auto industry and the government to take cybersecurity seriously.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 자동차의 역사에 관한 서술은 사이버 보안 시연의 흐름과 무관하므로 ④가 정답이다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③ 은 시연의 전개이고 ⑤ 는 그 결론이다.

order.given: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road. Although these cars have many benefits, experts warn that having more self-driving cars also means having more potential targets for hackers.

blocks.A: To show this, researchers recently ran a demonstration proving that even today’s smart cars are vulnerable, using a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it.
blocks.B: They were able not only to change the radio’s volume and switch the wipers on, but also to seize the transmission and stop the car as it moved down the highway.
blocks.C: Fortunately it was only a demonstration, but it sent a clear message to both the auto industry and the government that automotive cybersecurity must be taken seriously.

order.explanation_ko: 시연의 도입(A) → 시연에서 가능했던 조작의 범위(B) → 시연의 함의와 결론(C) 순서가 자연스럽다.
order.distractor_ko: B 의 "They" 는 A 의 researchers 를 받으므로 A 가 앞서야 하고, C 는 "it was only a demonstration" 으로 앞의 시연 전체를 받으므로 마지막이다.

insert.insert_sentence: Worse still, their control was not limited to comfort features.

passage_marked.text: There will soon be many self-driving cars with internet access on the road.
Researchers recently proved through a demonstration that even smart cars are vulnerable.
They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it, changing the radio and the air conditioner.
They also took control of the transmission and stopped the car as it drove down the highway.
It was just a demonstration, but the message to the industry and the government was clear.

insert.explanation_ko: "편의 장치에 그치지 않았다"는 문장은 편의 장치 조작이 언급된 뒤, 주행 제어가 나오기 전에 와야 하므로 ③이 적절하다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①② 자리에서는 아직 편의 장치 조작이 나오지 않아 대비가 성립하지 않는다. ④⑤ 는 이미 주행 제어가 서술된 뒤라 늦다.

passage: Self-driving cars with internet access will soon be common on the road.
Experts warn that more such cars also means more potential targets for hackers.
Researchers took over a car from a computer while someone else was driving it.
They controlled comfort features and then the transmission, stopping the car.
The event was only a demonstration, but its message was serious.
Automotive cybersecurity is a real issue for both industry and government.
summary.summary_template: A demonstration in which researchers remotely __(A)__ a moving car showed that connecting more vehicles to the internet makes automotive cybersecurity a __(B)__ concern.
summary.explanation_ko: 연구진이 달리는 차를 원격으로 제어했으므로 (A)는 controlled, 사이버 보안이 실제 문제라고 했으므로 (B)는 genuine 이다.
summary.distractor_ko: (A) repaired·designed 는 시연의 내용과 다르다. (B) minor·distant 는 "real issue ... taken seriously" 와 반대다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그것은 자동차 업계와 정부 양쪽 모두에게 분명한 메시지를 보낸다.
writing.answer: It sends a clear message to both the auto industry and the government.
writing.explanation_ko: both A and B 가 전치사 to 의 목적어 자리에서 명사구끼리 병렬을 이룬다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 자동차 사이버 보안은 진지하게 다뤄져야 할 실제 문제이다.
conditions: 조동사 must 와 수동태를 사용할 것
writing.answer: Automotive cybersecurity is a real issue that must be taken seriously.
writing.explanation_ko: 주격 관계대명사 that 뒤에 「조동사 + be + p.p.」 형태의 수동태를 쓴다.

writing.question: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
writing.context: The demonstration proved that even today’s smart cars are ___________, because researchers could seize them from a distance.
writing.explanation_ko: 원격으로 장악당했다는 것은 방어에 취약하다는 뜻이므로 vulnerable 이 적절하다.

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.context: They used a computer to take control of a car while someone else was driving it.
writing.answer: 그들은 다른 누군가가 그 차를 운전하고 있는 동안에 차를 장악하기 위해 컴퓨터를 사용했다.
writing.explanation_ko: to take 는 목적을 나타내는 to부정사이고, while 절의 과거진행형이 동시 진행을 나타낸다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Because internet-connected cars can be seized from a distance, more self-driving cars means more __(A)__ for hackers, making automotive __(B)__ a serious issue.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문의 more potential targets for hackers 와 automotive cybersecurity 에서 각각 가져온다.

writing.question: 본문의 주제를 한 문장의 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 인터넷에 연결된 차가 늘어날수록 해커가 노릴 표적도 늘어난다.
writing.answer: The more internet-connected cars there are, the more targets hackers have.
writing.explanation_ko: 「the 비교급 ~, the 비교급 ...」 구문으로 비례 관계를 나타낸다.
